description: Every FlowDoc 0.3 reference type in the blocks that hold them: a flow and a tasktemplate reference in the typed create_task sub-block and an assistant reference in create_wisdom_session (tasks/D05), a casetemplate reference and casefield reference keys in the typed create_case sub-block and a casefield reference as a list item in get_case (tasks/D06, conformance/hcl/README.md rule 11), and a phonenumber and a flow reference in the typed start_outbound_chat_contact sub-block (tasks/D04), with an address for every reference: the emit-tf case of the same name, as provider-shaped HCL. awaits-provider: the published provider's refs key pattern does not know the five types until the release that reads 0.3 (tasks/D10).
